content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lawrenceville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's eligibility criteria to verify you meet the required combination of formal education and hours leading projects. Granite PM Academy staff can answer eligibility questions during a brief consultation.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. This formal education covers the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Attend all sessions to earn your 35 contact hours—a non-negotiable PMI requirement for PMP eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, submit your PMP application directly to PMI. Include proof of your contact hours from Granite PM Academy, your education credentials, and project-experience documentation. Pay the associated PMI exam fee to activate your application and reserve your exam date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to reinforce your learning. Schedule your proctored PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. On exam day, demonstrate your knowledge of project-management processes and the PMBOK® Guide domains.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Once certified, you must earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses and resources to help you stay current with evolving project-management practices and maintain your professional standing.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
